description: This Java class, SearchModelJsonExamplesProducer, generates example JSON files related to search models and authorization contexts within the Ditto framework. It creates sample data including authorization subjects, access control lists, and search results, and writes them to JSON files for testing or demonstration purposes.

classes.name: SearchModelJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that programmatically generates example JSON files for search results and authorization contexts in the Ditto framework.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point that takes a directory path argument and initiates JSON file generation.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates authorization context JSON files within the specified root directory.

methods.name: produceSearchModel
methods.description: Generates sample search result and ACL JSON files within the specified directory.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON string and writes it to a file.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a raw JSON string to the specified file path.
